say:3:1221618001:0.text: Those guys were shouting for us at the door earlier, but I was too scared to meet them. They were here to...?
say:3:1221618001:0.source_cn: 刚才那帮兄弟在门口喊了半天，我也不敢出来。他们是来……

choice_prompt:4:1221618001.text: Those guys were shouting for us at the door earlier, but I was too scared to meet them. They were here to...?
choice_prompt:4:1221618001.source_cn: 刚才那帮兄弟在门口喊了半天，我也不敢出来。他们是来……

say:5:1221618002:0.text: Huh? Come on, I was only taking a short break just now! We've got so much to handle every day...
say:5:1221618002:0.source_cn: 啊？不是吧！我就是稍微休息了一会……毕竟每天那么多活儿……
say:5:1221618002:0.male: Huh? Come on, I was only taking a short break just now! We've got so much to handle every day...
say:5:1221618002:0.female: Huh? Come on, I was only taking a short break just now! We've got so much to handle every day...

say:6:1221618003:0.text: Short break? I haven't seen you work all day! Isn't it a bit late to start worrying about the consequences?
say:6:1221618003:0.source_cn: “休息一会”？我可是一天都没看见你干活！现在知道害怕了？

say:8:1221618007:0.text: The truth is, they were here to compliment our outstanding work today.
say:8:1221618007:0.source_cn: 其实，他们刚刚是在夸我们，说我们今天的工作很出色。

say:11:1221618008:0.text: Outstanding work? W—We got a compliment?!
say:11:1221618008:0.source_cn: 工作出色？我们……我们被表扬了？

say:12:1221618009:0.text: Even though you didn't do the work... but yes, we got a compliment! That's the first since I've been here!
say:12:1221618009:0.source_cn: 虽然干活的人不是你们……但没错，咱们勤务工被表扬了！这...

say:13:1221618010:1.text: They are determined to fight for better pay for you all. Plus, they promised to stop bossing you around!
say:13:1221618010:1.source_cn: 他们打算帮你们争取更多的工钱。对了，还说不会再对你们呼...

say:16:1221618011:0.text: ...That's wonderful! We only slack off because we're exhausted, underpaid, and get beat up if we don't do things right.
say:16:1221618011:0.source_cn: ……太好了！我们偷懒，还不是因为又累又没钱，干不好还会被骂。

say:19:1221618012:0.text: Exactly. We'll be more motivated if they appreciate our hard work.
say:19:1221618012:0.source_cn: 对啊，要是大家能看到我们的辛苦，我们也不会一点干劲都没有。

choice_prompt:20:1221618012.text: Exactly. We'll be more motivated if they appreciate our hard work.
choice_prompt:20:1221618012.source_cn: 对啊，要是大家能看到我们的辛苦，我们也不会一点干劲都没有。

say:21:1221618013:0.text: Indeed. Our future looks so much more promising now!
say:21:1221618013:0.source_cn: 是啊，以后的日子可有盼头多了！
say:21:1221618013:0.male: Indeed. Our future looks so much more promising now!
say:21:1221618013:0.female: Indeed. Our future looks so much more promising now!

say:22:1221618014:0.text: Actually, I've been wondering who these guys are. Are they our guests?
say:22:1221618014:0.source_cn: 对了，我刚才就想问，他们几个是谁，是我们的客人吗？

say:23:1221618015:0.text: Them? They are the new recruits.
say:23:1221618015:0.source_cn: 他们？他们是新来的勤务工啊！

say:26:1221618016:0.text: But... Lucca said yesterday that the new recruits would only arrive tomorrow...
say:26:1221618016:0.source_cn: 可是……昨儿我听二当家说，新人要明天才能到呢……

say:30:1221618017:0.text: We already told you we didn't work here, but you dragged us off to work without hearing us out!
say:30:1221618017:0.source_cn: 我们早就说过不是啦，可大叔你根本就不听，抓着我们就去干活了！

say:31:1221618018:0.text: Huh? Goodness gracious, I—I feel so bad for making you work all day...
say:31:1221618018:0.source_cn: 啊？哎呀，这……这可怎么好意思，让你们忙活了一整天……

choice_prompt:32:1221618018.text: Huh? Goodness gracious, I—I feel so bad for making you work all day...
choice_prompt:32:1221618018.source_cn: 啊？哎呀，这……这可怎么好意思，让你们忙活了一整天……

say:33:1221618019:1.text: Magister's right! We're happy to play a part in solving such a big issue!
say:33:1221618019:1.source_cn: 主人说得对！能解决这么大的问题，我们也很满足呢！
say:33:1221618019:1.male: Magister's right! We're happy to play a part in solving such a big issue!
say:33:1221618019:1.female: Magister's right! We're happy to play a part in solving such a big issue!

say:34:1221618021:1.text: Goodbye, Sir! I hope you won't take us as laborers again next time we meet!
say:34:1221618021:1.source_cn: 再见啦大叔，下次可不要不由分说就把我们当成勤务工啦！

say:35:1221618022:1.text: Thanks... Let me give you a proper welcome next time!
say:35:1221618022:1.source_cn: 谢谢……下次再见，我们一定会好好招待你们的！

choice:32:0:1.text: It's been a tiring but fulfilling day.
choice:32:0:1.male: It's been a tiring but fulfilling day.
choice:32:0:1.female: It's been a tiring but fulfilling day.

say:37:1221618020:1.text: The takeaway of this is: Life is an exhausting but fulfilling journey!
say:37:1221618020:1.source_cn: 体验心得是：虽然生活很累，但也很有成就感！

say:38:1221618004:0.text: What? That's unlikely! It's a miracle already if they don't rail against us for being lazy...
say:38:1221618004:0.source_cn: 什么？怎么可能！他们不骂我们偷懒就不错了……
say:38:1221618004:0.male: What? That's unlikely! It's a miracle already if they don't rail against us for being lazy...
say:38:1221618004:0.female: What? That's unlikely! It's a miracle already if they don't rail against us for being lazy...

say:39:1221618005:1.text: So you actually know you're being lazy!
say:39:1221618005:1.source_cn: 原来你也知道自己在偷懒呀！
